title: The Liquid Metal Battery: Innovation in stationary electricity storage
summary: MIT's Donald Sadoway presents the liquid metal battery as a design for grid-scale stationary electricity storage, at an Imperial College London event in 2018. He covers the grid benefits of massive-scale storage.
why: HN brings it up in energy storage threads as a promising scalable grid storage technology, and calls it worth the hour.

quote.text: It's an hour long, but it's well worth the time investment.
